fete.titre: Celebrate all arrivals in the heart of the butterfly island
texte: The city of Pointe-à-Pitre, located on the island of Grande-Terre, remains the historic home port of the race and boasts a rich and diverse architectural heritage, which, first and foremost, reflects its historical role and forms a strong component of its identity. Founded in the mid-18th century on the marshy shores of the Petit Cul-de-Sac Marin bay, it developed around this body of water, an exceptional anchorage for ships.

ville.titre: The Mémorial ACTe, at the heart of the finishes and of passing on history
texte: An emblematic landmark of Pointe-à-Pitre, the Mémorial ACTe will host the finish village of the 13th Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe on its esplanade.
The public will be able to follow the skippers’ arrivals there, discover local know-how and produce, and enjoy a cultural programme showcasing Guadeloupean and Caribbean talent.
Beyond the sporting adventure, the Mémorial ACTe will also offer a look at the history of the Atlantic and the memories associated with it.

Through “La Traversée”, the cultural and remembrance programme running from 5 to 15 November, visitors will be invited to discover the many histories that have shaped Guadeloupean society, in particular those of the transatlantic slave trade, slavery and migration.

Talks, documentary resources, genealogy consultations and educational initiatives will make it possible to approach these memories with respect for their distinct nature and to foster dialogue between generations.
ville.chute: A place where sporting emotion, the island’s cultural richness and the passing on of our history come together.

venue.titre: Plan your visit to the MACTe
texte: MACTe is located on Rue Raspail, on the Darboussier site, 97110 Pointe-à-Pitre (Grande-Terre, Guadeloupe).
liste: On foot from the city centre, allow approximately 10 to 15 minutes from Place de la Victoire or the port.
From Pôle Caraïbes airport, the distance is approximately 7 to 8 km.
By taxi, the journey takes approximately 15 minutes depending on traffic.
By car, simply follow the signs for Pointe-à-Pitre centre / Darboussier.
